scope: Physical M1 iPad on its 8 W adapter, Calendar Week on the isolated stress fixture, same signed build for all three windows (built before the change that reports a hang ending as the app leaves the foreground; that change does not touch the idle path). Process counters from the device sampler every 5 s; the first 90 s after launch are excluded. The paused window turns the detector off as a measurement control only. A fourth (paused) window was cut short by a host restart and is omitted.
result: With the run-loop monitor running, idle Calendar woke 0.46 and 0.33 times per second against 0.32 paused. The half-second heartbeat it replaced measured 2.19 running and 0.26-0.27 paused in the same setup. Window 1 contains one 1.28 s CPU burst; window 2 has none.
hangCapture: Physical iPhone 14 Pro, same build: a deliberate 2.8 s main-thread stall was reported with a captured stack in 2 of 2 runs.
